charset=utf-8",     body = charToRaw(paste("The proxy could not reach the app:", conditionMessage(e)))   ) } proxy_forward = function(request, app_port) {   # Replays a request against the app on this machine and returns the app's response    # The path comes from the other side; a path that does not start with "/", such as   # "@example.com/", would change the host the request goes to   if (!startsWith(request$path, "/")) {     stop("The request path must start with \"/\".")   }   handle = curl::new_handle(customrequest = request$method, followlocation = FALSE)   curl::handle_setheaders(handle, .list = proxy_header_list(request$headers))   if (length(request$body) > 0) {     curl::handle_setopt(handle, copypostfields = request$body)   }   url = paste0("http://127.0.0.1:", app_port, request$path)   res = curl::curl_fetch_memory(url, handle = handle)   headers = curl::parse_headers(res$headers)[-1]   list(status = res$status_code, headers = proxy_clean_headers(headers), body = res$content) }  proxy_answer = function(conn, app_port, max_bytes) {   # Answers one request that arrived on `conn` and closes the connection    on.exit(conn$close())   request = proxy_receive(conn, max_bytes)   if (is.null(request)) {     return(invisible())   }   response = tryCatch(proxy_forward(request, app_port), error = proxy_error)   proxy_send(conn, response[c("status", "headers")], response$body) }  proxy_share = function(app_port, max_bytes = 1e8) {   # Makes the app listening on `app_port` of this machine reachable through a new address    srv = TailcatServer$new()   lst = srv$listen(proxy_port)   lst$serve(\(conn) proxy_answer(conn, app_port, max_bytes))   address = tailcat_reveal(srv$address)   cli::cli_inform(c(     "Sharing the app on port {app_port}.
